name: YNX Seller Console
title: YNX Seller Console | Merchant Operations on YNX Chain
description: Operate YNX Chain stores with least-privilege team roles, catalog and inventory controls, fulfillment workflows, settlement evidence, audited exports and fail-closed recovery controls.
features: Owner, Admin, Catalog, Inventory, Fulfillment, Finance, Support and Viewer roles
Wallet-account-bound team invitations and store-scoped revocation
Catalog, inventory, order and fulfillment operations
Authoritative Pay and Trust evidence boundaries
Snapshot v6 migration, bounded rollback and verified restore
truthBoundaries: Local tests do not prove central Wallet, Pay, Trust or Data Fabric acceptance.
Historical staging for commit 38e2f68 is not current-source deployment evidence.
The requested canonical URL is not public proof until Owner 28 deploys and verifies the current source metadata.
Manual shipment state remains seller_entered_unverified without a trusted carrier adapter.

faq.question: Is YNX Seller Console publicly deployed?
faq.answer: Not for the current source commit. The repository contains locally tested implementation and a pending Website handoff; public deployment remains false until directly verified.

faq.question: Can Seller Console mark an order paid by itself?
faq.answer: No. Paid and refunded states require exact committed evidence from the authoritative YNX Pay boundary.

faq.question: How are Seller team permissions protected?
faq.answer: First membership requires acceptance by the exact invited Wallet account, permissions fail closed, and local revocation occurs before central session invalidation is attempted.

faq.question: Can rollback silently delete Seller authority records?
faq.answer: No. Rollback is an explicit export to Snapshot v3, v4 or v5 and fails when the target cannot represent invitations, revocations or Seller events.
